plan.title: Opt-in typed policy gate for value feedback (default OFF)

narratives.Description: Introduce a typed plan.policy.valueFeedback policy block that defaults to OFF and gates the entire value-attribution feature. Add granular sub-flags for event emission, session line, and upstream prompt, plus a capability-cost disclosure printed when a consumer enables it.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Add the typed valueFeedback schema to the policy module and a policy:show --field=valueFeedback reader.
- Print a capability-cost disclosure at enable time and add tests asserting the master flag short-circuits every downstream code path.
narratives.UserStory: As a directive consumer, I want a default-off typed policy flag, so that no value-feedback behavior or token cost occurs until I explicitly opt in.

items.title: Master flag gates all downstream code paths

narrative.Acceptance: When valueFeedback.enabled is false, the gate rejects all emit, session-line, and upstream-prompt code paths.
Enabling the flag persists the typed policy value only after it shows a capability-cost disclosure.
policy:show --field=valueFeedback returns the resolved enabled state and every sub-flag value.

expected_outputs: Typed valueFeedback policy block defaulting OFF with granular sub-flags
Capability-cost disclosure printed at enable time

references.title: Issue #1709: Epic: Directive value attribution & adoption loop (RFC)
